origin: An assistant-invented per-shot seed formula, with a validator asserting every seed was unique. Retired in 1.0.1; per-shot seeds removed in 1.0.2.
problem: Uniqueness was being checked as though it were a quality. It is not. Identity comes from the model sheet, not the seed; and two shots of the SAME set-up should be able to share a seed so they match.

policy.identity: conditioned on the approved sheet — the seed never carries identity
policy.same_setup: shots that are the same set-up at a different moment MAY share a seed; that is how they stay consistent
policy.edits_and_variations: use the base shot's seed plus the edit instruction
policy.record: every generated frame records its seed so it can be reproduced

validator_change: Uniqueness is no longer asserted. Presence and reproducibility are.
